checks.title: Confirm adoption decision and owner
checks.instructions: Name product owner, first read-only result, feature decision options and excluded issue, flag, customer and experiment actions.

checks.title: Bind exact released feature
checks.instructions: Verify tenant, product, feature, release/build, deployed time, flag revision and eligible segment. A plan or draft flag is not a shipped feature.

checks.title: Freeze eligible, exposure and use rules
checks.instructions: Record distinct-account identity join, internal/test exclusions, versioned predicates, window/timezone and equal-window policy before reading outcomes.

checks.title: Predeclare target and sample minimum
checks.instructions: Record use among exposed target, minimum exposed count and source-coverage rule. Partial or small samples stay not_evaluable.

checks.title: Bind Adoption and Product capabilities
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Product Adoption Analyst and Product Feedback Coordinator Crews and access; reuse compatible identities or propose reviewed creation.

checks.title: Probe release, analytics and issues
checks.instructions: Read exact release/flag, eligible, exposure, use and current issue records or scoped exports; record IDs, timestamps, join coverage and missing sources.

checks.title: Validate observation and decision
checks.instructions: Insert blocking validators before Product and reporting. Exercise wrong release, denominator, incomplete coverage, unsupported target, owner approval and product-change claims.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source paths, rule versions, validator steps, owner review, stable case key, manual route, optional event policy, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real released-feature case manually
checks.instructions: Save authorized source reads, both artifacts, validation, owner correction or decision and an incomplete-coverage control. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. An analytics or release event needs authenticated scope, stable IDs, deduplication, complete windows, rule-change reset, cost, owner notification and explicit activation.
